summary: Frontend-only verification of the 3 new UI changes for Bus' a Lead (Convict mode). All THREE features PASS end-to-end. (1) New canteen table background image ('/assets/new_canteen_table.webp') is used as the root game div backgroundImage and the entire play surface (seats, kitty, hand, cards) renders correctly on top with no layout breakage. (2) Yard Court Audit Auto-Flag works: when an AI opponent plays an illegal card, opening the pinned call-renege-btn → yard-court-modal auto-detects the offending book, adds a red pulsing dot on audit-book-N, applies rose styling, defaults the selected book to the first flagged one, renders audit-flag-<seat>-<book> with the reason (verified reason: 'Off-Suit Renege — held the led suit'), and puts a red .renege-ring around the illegal card. The engine is paused while the modal is open (audit-book count did not advance over 2.5s). (3) Renege Replay cutscene fires on a valid accusation: cutscene-renege overlay renders, the renege-replay element is present with the caught card (J♣), the 'INSTANT REPLAY' label, and the flag reason text. Settlement modal correctly shows 'RENEGE CONFIRMED' with proper transfers ($4 twice from DooLow to defenders, Spades Trump x2 multiplier). Regression clean: cutscenes still auto-dismiss, no crashes/hangs, pinned CALL RENEGE button visible across books.
critical_code_review_comments: YardCourtModal.flaggedBooks correctly filters only opponent seats (e.g.seat !== 'P') so a human's own illegal play won't be self-flagged — good.

CutsceneOverlay.renege-replay uses cutscene.data.card fetched from state.playLog by (renegeCall.seat, book) in useGame.settlementCutscene — verified to render the actual caught card (J♣) with correct reason.
TitleVideo and cutscene overlays now have WebM VP9 <source> added (from iter15 fix); videos actually play in Chromium — previous codec bug is resolved.
Minor: audit modal has no visible 'skip forward N books' when many books exist; not a bug but could improve UX in long hands.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Playwright approach that worked: 1) cfg-difficulty-hard + cfg-speed-fast + deal-btn. 2) Spam pass-btn AND click trump-S when it appears; occasionally hand becomes bidder if AI also passes. 3) CRITICAL: to progress books past 1, must CLICK PLAYABLE CARDS in the human hand. Cards use testid pattern 'card-{suit}-{rank}-{idx}' and live inside [data-testid="player-hand"]. Pick any card whose computed opacity>=0.5 and force-click it. 4) Every 6 steps open call-renege-btn → check for audit-flag-* elements. AI reneges appear within ~2 books in Convict mode when the human keeps playing. 5) On flag found, click accuse-<seat>-btn → wait for cutscene-renege → verify data-testid=renege-replay exists. Verified working: card-S-A-0 etc, player-hand, audit-flag-W-2, cutscene-renege, renege-replay. Also cutscene-skip-btn should be tried during auction because settlement cutscenes can block clicks.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found this iteration. Previous H.264 codec issue is resolved via added WebM <source>.
